title: Integer to Roman
statement_short: Given an integer num, convert it to a Roman numeral string. Symbol values are processed from largest to smallest, using subtractive form rules for values starting with 4 or 9.
hint: Small bounded input range (num <= 3999) allows greedy subtraction using a pre-defined array of value-symbol pairs.
keywords: convert it to a Roman numeral string
why_not: Right: Greedy repeatedly subtracts the largest matching Roman numeral value from num to construct the result string in O(1) time. Not Math / Geometry: Pure digit extraction works, but greedy matching against symbol tables is far cleaner. Not 1D DP: Storing state transitions is unnecessary because the greedy choice is always globally optimal. Not Trie: Prefix trees store string dictionaries, which do not apply to integer conversion.
